rows.summary: A compound Git status and file-listing probe exceeded its 10-second execution envelope before returning output.
Context-free closing-brace patch hunks inserted a state event into recommendations and a witness into state events while leaving the JSON syntactically valid.

The first 25-test current-phase replay failed because three x1 tests read mutable x2 lifecycle files and one x2 assertion expected lowercase same-owner while the overview began the label with an uppercase letter.
The first exact evidence-stage git diff --cached --check reported a new blank line at EOF in the shared v647-v4 runtime.
